question.problem: Find the greatest common divisor of $6\,624$ and $1\,265.$
question.worked_solution:
We use the Euclidean algorithm, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}6\,624 & = & 1\,265(5) & + & 299 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 1\,265 & = & 299(4) & + & 69 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 299 & = & 69(4) & + & 23 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 69 & = & 23(3) & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The last positive remainder is $23.$ Therefore, we conclude that the greatest common divisor of $6\,624$ and $1\,265$ is $23.$ Symbolically, we write

$$
\text{gcd}(6\,624,1\,265)=23.
$$
